text: やせいの　ポケモンが　でて　きても　そいつを　たたかわせて　いけば　となりまちへ　いける！

structure.jp: やせいの　ポケモンが　でて　きても
structure.en: even if wild Pokémon come out

structure.jp: そいつを　たたかわせて　いけば
structure.en: if you keep making that one fight

structure.jp: となりまちへ　いける！
structure.en: you can get to the next town!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after a て-form means 'even if'. Together with くる (coming toward you), でてきても = 'even if they come out at you'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing たたかう to たたかわせる means making someone else do the fighting. そいつをたたかわせて = 'making that one fight'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if'. After a て-form, いく adds the idea of keeping on as you go. たたかわせていけば = 'if you keep making it fight as you go'.
